text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — tiny-voca's creator says the 4.5-million-parameter, 18 MB text-to-speech model runs on a CPU and was trained without hearing a real human voice. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6542)

2 — Video: 51. Beni: Camera Robot (Persian) (https://t.me/dlmehr/6543)

3 — EmperoAI introduced quark, a 165-million-parameter model with 128K context and RL-only post-training, reporting four open-weight models and about $4,200 in total compute costs, including a failed design. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6544)

4 — Bloomberg, citing the Financial Times, reports that Jensen Huang is discussing a possible return to Nvidia days after its board ousted him as CEO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6545)

5 — Hill estimates Anthropic's IPO could make 4,250 employees millionaires, including about 50 worth over $100 million each, assuming a $1.5 trillion valuation above the company's reported $1 trillion target. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6546)

6 — OpenAI says physicist Nathaniel Craig worked with GPT-6 Astra on a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model, featured in its new science blog's first post. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6548)

7 — @dlmehr says they canceled Photoshop and Premiere subscriptions and will use Claude for video editing, noise reduction, sound and lighting adjustments, covers, shorts, Persian and English subtitles, and uploads. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6549)

8 — Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max with native vision, a new mixture-of-experts architecture and 1M-token context, claiming over 60% lower average task costs in internal tests and API pricing of $1.50 per million input tokens and $4.50 per million output tokens. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6550)

9 — Alibaba reports Qwen4-Max placed sixth in Code Arena: WebDev with a preliminary 1,750 points, 74 points above Qwen3.8-Max, and led Chinese models in HTML, Brand & Marketing, and Reference-Based Design. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6552)

--Hermes
